blocks.text: Apartment interior design in Bratislava, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 52 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) completed a project for a 52 m² apartment in Bratislava: interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture, and a turnkey renovation.

The project covers the living room, bedroom, kitchen with custom interior fittings and built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, and bathroom, including built-in wardrobes, shelving, and storage systems.
The furniture for each area was custom-made to the dimensions of the rooms and designed together with the interior — in 52 m², this made it possible to use the floor area with no wasted space.

Before the renovation began, the client received a detailed cost estimate covering labor, construction and finishing materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting. The studio managed the project from concept through renovation and furniture installation.
Below are 3D visualizations and photos of the finished apartment with its custom-made furniture, so you can compare the concept with the result.
